ETH.note: National Bank of Ethiopia QR standards mandate stated, but no licensing, switch oversight or regional link.
EthSwitch only wants to expand into cross-border payments; no corridor stated.

facts.fact: EthSwitch said in May 2026 that its EthioPay instant-payment service processed more than 1 million peer-to-peer transactions in a single day, worth 5.1 billion birr.
The article says the policy challenge is ensuring different providers can transact across a common set of rails, with EthioPay instant payments carrying peer-to-peer transfers.
EthSwitch is described as Ethiopia's national payment switch, linking banks, payment institutions and other participants with instant-payment infrastructure and interoperable QR payments.
